text:
maria: quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A — leadership asked for month-level clarity on the Lighthouse rollout (API knobs, Console traffic UX, Optimize cost recs).

sanjay: short summary: aiming for a staggered Q3/Q4 roll. can give target months and mark firm vs contingent.

anna: to confirm scope: API = latency/routing knobs + graceful fallback; Console = traffic-shaping UI + rollout controls; Optimize = cost recommendations + eval harness.

maria: ops question — how long should Dedicated reserve GPUs for the canary? need a hard number.

kevin: recommend 2 weeks by default. canary start target = Nov 1. if kernel-routing patch slips, shift everything by ~4 weeks.

anna: tentative targets: API beta = Aug; Console beta = Sep; Optimize v1 = Oct; Dedicated canary = Nov 1.

sanjay: commit level: canary start = Nov 1 (firm). other dates = targets with explicit fallback (+4w) if infra patches delay.

maria: SDK/clients concern?

kevin: SDK team needs an integration freeze Aug 15 -> Sep 5. please avoid interface changes then.

ops-bot: Note: action created -> /eng-docs/lighthouse/onepager (by anna).

anna: action: i'll publish a one-pager this week with gating metrics, fallback offsets, and canary length. tagging @cs for canary customer nominations.

maria: thanks — please @announce in #eng-platform and include release windows so PMs can lock calendars.
